title: Verify both are required — the Fees & Discounts feature on AND the matching permission
custom_preconds:
1. Ability to toggle the Fees & Discounts feature for the org.
2. A ZZAUTOTEST role with See Financial Data and Work Orders: Create and Edit ON.
3. An open work order.
custom_steps:
1. With the feature off (any permission), look for fee/discount controls.
2. With the feature on but the permission off, look again.
3. With the feature on and the permission on, use the control.
custom_expected:
1. Feature off: no fee/discount controls anywhere (except the audit log).
2. Feature on but permission off: controls hidden / action refused.
3. Feature on and permission on: controls appear and the action works.
4. A user needs both the feature and the permission.
